featured_reviews.name: Vedant Rao
featured_reviews.review_text: Varsha Stationery is a good neighborhood stationery shop with a nice range of products. I got custom stickers made from them and also had gifts wrapped. For the custom stickers, I specifically wanted a tear-and-stick size, and they completely understood the assignment. One of the staff members was extremely helpful—he understood exactly what I wanted and quietly delivered without unnecessary back and forth. They have a good collection of stationery items, especially gift-wrapping papers, gift bags, and other essentials.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Varma
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited this stationery shop yesterday to buy Sundaram A5 size sheets. It costed Rs 55, but the owner quoted ₹75, despite questioning him again. I was in a rush, so I couldn’t verify the price and accepted it. He was busy talking to a woman and didn’t pay attention to me. When he handed me change, he gave me ₹30 instead of ₹25. I had to return the extra ₹5 because he was distracted. People say he has a habit of overcharging customers. Overall, my experience was disappointing, and I wouldn’t recommend this shop.

featured_reviews.name: DR. QAYUM MUKADDAM
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of my favourite places. The store is nicely kept and maintained. They have almost everything in stationery and beyond. People working here are very efficient, quick and helpful. Just one small suggestion-It would be better if they have a smile on their faces, except for Shailesh and the person at the Counter. Shailesh is the life and soul of the shop, moving about swiftly, knowing exactly what is kept where. He is very soft spoken and kind. I have never seen him lose his cool or 'not smiling'
He even guides and directs his colleagues in s very nice manner do that they too learn quickly and provide full customer satisfaction.

featured_reviews.name: Parth Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
NEGATIVE RATING!
Very high prices compared to other stationeries. And nothing superior about it except that it is air conditioned which isn't actually a requirement from the customer angle for a stationery. Got spiral binding done but it wasn't done properly, pages were torne and the binding was not proper. NOT RECOMMENDED AT ALL. There are much better and cheaper stationeries around.
Also, the guy at the counter was rude when i told him that the binding wasn't properly done. I was not even telling him to do it again, was just giving a feedback.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to get a small zine printed, but no stationery or xerox shop was willing to help. There’s a Chedda (always crowded) right next to this one, but they weren’t much of help either. They kept saying the sizing is wrong, the paper won’t work or some other issue. It was already getting late, and I really needed the zine done the same day since it was a gift for the next day.

That’s when I noticed this uncrowded stationery and xerox shop right next to it and decided to give it one last shot. He said it looked difficult at first, but he still gave it a try and ended up making it exactly how I wanted. All with a smile, even though it was getting late.

Thank you so, so much 🥺
